cover_letter_text:
Hi Pavement Asset Services team,

I'm Marc. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. Your advert is open to graduates, and the road and pavement work you do is what I studied.

In the diploma I worked on road geometry, pavement design and earthworks, and studied the Austroads guides and AS 1289 soil testing standards. On site in the Philippines I did inspections and quality checks and wrote site and progress reports.

I'd move to Adelaide and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa) and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
advert_text:
Pavement Asset Services (PAS) is an engineering company based at Hindmarsh, South Australia.  We deliver professional civil and environmental engineering services to a diverse range of market sectors, such as State Government, Local Government, Logistics, Ports, Airports, Residential Development and Commercial Development.
PAS has highly regarded, with market leading expertise in all aspects of roads, pavements and related civil engineering activities, including environmental services. Our expertise is derived from our engineering leadership team with over 125 years of combined industry experience. Our services include:
- Pavement, geotechnical and environmental investigation – visual, invasive (e.g. boreholes, logging, field testing, sampling and lab testing) and non-invasive, using our advanced Falling Weight Deflectometer pavement tester.
- Engineering analysis and design – pavement and earthworks design for new and existing pavements.
- Engineering and design management - full service design.
- Construction services – Including project management, superintendency, and construction surveillance.
We are an equal opportunity employer, with a broad range of female and male engineers, age groups and ethnicities working for us.
For more information about PAS, please refer to paveassets.com.au and our Linked In page.
About the role
PAS are now ready to employ another Graduate Civil Engineer or Civil Engineer, with 0 – 5 years’ experience in its team.  Given our diverse range of services and clients, we can readily utilise someone with experience in any of the service categories above.  We also offer the opportunity to develop your skills in other areas, creating a dynamic, varied and interesting role.
- Pavement, geotechnical and environmental site investigations and testing.
- Civil engineering analysis and design.
- Construction surveillance and advice.
- Project management and design management.
- Business development and estimating.
This is an exciting opportunity to join a Company with sustained, ongoing growth.
The Successful Candidate 
The successful candidate will have: 
- A degree in Civil Engineering or Civil & Environmental Engineering
- 0 – 5 plus years’ experience will be accepted. Candidates with experience in civil engineering, road works or pavements, with be looked upon favorably.
- Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, with a demonstrated ability to develop relationships with team members and other stakeholders.
- Solid IT, report writing and verbal communication skills.
- An unrivalled commitment to quality.
 In return we offer
- Access to market leading expertise is pavements, materials, environmental engineering, roads and ports.
- The opportunity to work on a broad range of infrastructure projects from Local Roads to DIT’s largest major projects.
- Opportunities for growth and career development, with a supported mentorship and training program.
- A competitive remuneration and benefits package.
